name: infrachecks-reports
title: InfraChecks Reports: monthly availability PDF by email
author: InfraChecks
description: Measures monthly availability for the systems listed in ~/etc/infrachecks/systems.csv from Livestatus state history, excluding planned downtime, with optional shift-hours measurement. Builds a PDF with this month, the target and a 12-month average, and emails it. Run bin/infrachecks-reports on the 1st of each month as the site user. GPLv2.
